scope.comparison: Actual separator drags, desktop min/max clamp, persisted reload width, collapse/restore, selected highlighted calc.py preview, and representative theme stills.

comparisonSummary: 13 named direct DOM samples paired; maximum observed settled geometry difference 0 px, 0 comparable stable-field differences. Exact scope and sampled fields are in the comparison JSON.
limits: This evidence compares the specified genuine Before and After revisions; it is not a claim of pixel identity, exhaustive UI coverage, or a speed/performance improvement.
The central film is curated from labelled source intervals at 25 fps without editorial speed changes. Complete original PNGs and MP4s are in the ZIP.

The source recorder caps an unchanged initial lead-in at one second and holds the final frame at least one second. Per-source capture-clock and encoded durations are retained; these can differ without changing action intervals.
No credentials, provider connection, login submission, or model invocation was used. The genuine unconfigured-model banner remains visible.

The After phone source reports one screenshot capture miss and includes a 2.624-second static screenshot delay around the reloaded 160px state. The raw receipt and recording are retained; no guarantee is made that every motion frame was captured.
The 160–480 px range is shown in the desktop drag/clamp exercise. The phone film exercises 224→160→reload160→224; it does not claim that all supported tree widths fit a phone viewport.
At the desktop 480 px limit, the remaining preview space is narrow in both revisions. Existing narrow-layout behavior is retained.
The selected file remains calc.py after reload while its src folder naturally collapses; the actual highlighted code readout is recorded.
The central desktop footage uses a labelled actual top-right source crop after a clean full-viewport lead. The full unmodified recordings remain in the ZIP.

One initial Files recipe click timeout occurred before recording, when an already active Files control closed the drawer. It was retained in the receipt, followed by a healthy doctor check, reload and successful retry.
